newsitem.title: CHINA: China police arrest 15-year-old for killing mother.
newsitem.headline: China police arrest 15-year-old for killing mother.

text.p: Chinese police have arrested a 15-year-old student for killing his mother after she beat him for playing video games, the Beijing Youth Daily said on Thursday.
The boy, identified only by his surname Zhang, strangled his mother at their Fengnan city home in the northern province of Hebei on April 14.
Zhang hired a classmate whom he promised to pay 400 yuan ($48) to help in the killing, it said.
Zhang confessed after police, called in to search for his missing mother, found her body in the family's cellar. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
